name: Coin Rally
description: A little 3D arcade race: drive round the park, pick up the twelve spinning coins as fast as you can and beat your best time.

descriptions.en: A little 3D arcade race: drive round the park, pick up the twelve spinning coins as fast as you can and beat your best time.
descriptions.it: Una piccola corsa arcade in 3D: guida per il parco, raccogli le dodici monete il più in fretta possibile e batti il tuo record.
